tool_input.summary: Fixed navbar toggle exclusivity for chat, settings, and right panel. The root cause was that all three toggle panel handler creators (createTogglePanelHandler, createKeyedTogglePanelHandler, createSingleKeyTogglePanelHandler) and the docs case in useAppCommands were doing simple boolean toggles instead of using the existing getNextPanelVisibilityFromToggle function which enforces mutual exclusivity via EXCLUSIVE_SIDE_PANEL_KEYS. Updated all four locations to use getNextPanelVisibilityFromToggle so that activating any of rightSidePanel/chat/settings automatically deactivates the other two.
